acceptance: DEC-0006 at GATE-0002; until accepted, the canonical pack governs on any conflict

layers.decides: acceptance of canon facts, rules, and releases
acceptance of briefs, arcs, and release structures
creative acceptance of exact asset versions
resolution or waiver of continuity findings
commercial acceptance where applicable (Commerce Foundry authority)
publication authorization or runtime release acceptance by the authority host

binding_rules: Every receipt binds to exact content hashes and versions.
A material change invalidates only the affected approval layers.
No layer's approval implies any other layer's approval; creative approval never implies commercial or publication approval.
An agent, model, tool, workflow, or connector cannot grant any approval, including of its own output.
No state transition is inferred from side effects (downloads, provider completion, comments).
